main.description: A user review of an AT Store directory listing. Subject is the at:// URI of the listing's record: a fyi.atstore.listing.detail for apps, or a games.atmosphere.define for games listed from atmosphere.games.

subject.description: AT URI of the listing being reviewed: a fyi.atstore.listing.detail or games.atmosphere.define record.

text.description: Optional written review; omit for a stars-only rating.
